resources.string: Misri App Manager — ek-ek karke, turant sab ek saath nahi
Ek tap se queue shuru hoti hai, andar Misri Settings khol kar ek-ek app ka button dabati hai. Har app par 2-4 second lagte hain. Screen on rakhna, beech me Settings ko mat chhedna.
Accessibility: OFF — pehle ON karo, warna koi action chalega nahi
Accessibility: ON — Misri Settings khol kar buttons daba sakti hai
Usage Access: OFF — size nahi dikhega (optional, kaam phir bhi chalega)
Usage Access: ON — cache/data size dikh raha hai
Data clear karne se logout, settings reset aur bina backup ke WhatsApp chats bhi chale jayenge. Do baar confirm karne ke baad hi chalega.
